plugin.description: Creates reminders in the tasks.org Android app and exposes the user's task lists so an agent can choose a destination.

actions.name: create_reminder
actions.description: Create a task in the tasks.org app. Use instanceId from the reminders/list source to choose a list; otherwise the configured list or the user's default list is used. due_iso is an absolute RFC3339 instant and must include the requested wall time's real UTC offset (for example, 2026-08-27T14:30:00-07:00 for 2:30 PM in Los Angeles, never 14:30:00Z). notify_before_ms adds an early notification when a due time is supplied.

due_iso.description: Optional absolute RFC3339 due time with Z or a numeric UTC offset.

timezone.description: Optional IANA time-zone name supplied by Index for context.

notify_before_ms.description: Optional early-notification lead in milliseconds; used only with due_iso.

instanceId.description: Optional tasks.org list id from the reminders/list source.
